name: Josiah McGrath
public_footprint:
Josiah D. McGrath of Potsdam, NY made the SUNY Canton President's List for academic achievement during the Fall 2016 semester, an honor for full-time students with a 3.75+ GPA.
Sources: https://canton.meritpages.com/stories/Congratulations-Josiah-McGrath-for-making-the-SUNY-Canton-President-s-List-/8110846
